steps.label: All-to-all connectivity
steps.sub: Every ion shares the chain's motional modes — no relay ions needed

steps.label: A physical consequence
steps.sub: Not a software feature — it follows directly from how the chain is coupled

steps.label: Sharp contrast
steps.sub: A superconducting qubit is wired to only 2-4 fixed physical neighbors

steps.label: No SWAP routing
steps.sub: Superconducting chips need inserted SWAP gates to connect distant qubits

steps.label: Shallower compiled circuits
steps.sub: Long-range or irregular connectivity patterns compile with far fewer gates

steps.label: Fewer gates, less error
steps.sub: Every gate carries some error chance — skipping SWAPs skips that cost

steps.label: Motional mode crowding
steps.sub: Longer chains pack vibrational modes closer together — harder to address cleanly

steps.label: Ion shuttling
steps.sub: Physically move ions between trap zones to bring the right pair together

steps.label: Photonic interconnects
steps.sub: Entangle separate traps via single photons sent down optical fiber

subtitle: Same physics, different engineering choices — and numbers worth staying skeptical of.
